patterns.note: Sections are presented as full-screen or near full-screen typographic statements, creating a vertical, chapter-like reading experience.
The site uses extremely oversized, decorative serif fonts for primary headings, often in multiple languages, contrasting with a more legible, elegant serif for body text and smaller labels.
A high-contrast, monochromatic black and white color scheme dominates, with a single vibrant green used exclusively for the primary call to action.
As the user scrolls, large typographic sections animate into view, often sliding up or fading in, replacing the previous content in a sequential, narrative progression.
Each major scroll depth reveals a new, distinct content block introduced by a monumental typographic statement, often featuring the typeface itself as a visual element.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero with a large, centered text overlay introduces the site, with the text scrolling away to reveal subsequent content.
Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal large, multi-lingual typographic sections, creating a dramatic, sequential narrative as the user scrolls down the page.
The design employs a minimalist, high-contrast aesthetic with a black background and white text, reserving a single bright accent color for interactive elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, decorative serif headings (many times body size) with a refined, elegant serif for body copy and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, with significant vertical whitespace between major content blocks, emphasizing each typographic statement.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its audacious use of monumental, multi-lingual typography as the primary visual and narrative driver, presenting the typeface itself as a work of art through a series of dramatic, scroll-triggered reveals.
